title: Commit with a specific message
phrases: commit these changes with this message
write a commit with my message
record this change in git history

safety.rule: Previews the diff --stat and requires the exact confirmation COMMIT. Also requires the operator's own GIT_MANAGER_ALLOW_COMMIT=true environment flag, and an optional GIT_REMOTE_OWNER match, before writing. Never force-pushes, rewrites history, or touches a branch other than the current one.
